inbound_manual_copy: Select the value and copy it manually.
inbound_help: A signed event with the exact saved command starts this card’s reviewed workflow. The URL and IDs are identifiers; the sender must authenticate separately. Results remain private canvas notes. This does not publish content.
inbound_command_help: Exact, case-sensitive name: 1–64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens. This selects the saved action; it does not run a terminal command.
inbound_prompt_edit_help: This is the connected prompt card. Saving updates that card, then saves the event rule disabled. Review the effective instructions and context before enabling.
inbound_prompt_graph_help: Instructions come from connected prompt cards. Edit or connect those cards directly; multiple prompts are combined in the review without silently replacing any of them.
inbound_prompt_required: Enter instructions in the connected prompt card first.
inbound_consent: Allow matching signed events to start this reviewed workflow until I disable it. I have checked the destination, saved instructions and context.
inbound_rotate_confirm: Replace the signing secret? The previous secret stops working and the rule is disabled until reviewed and enabled again.
inbound_secret_help: Shown once. Give it only to your event sender and store it securely. It will be cleared when this dialog closes. The URL alone cannot authenticate events.
inbound_external_help: External agent: its MCP client must stay connected and poll for work. Accepting an event does not confirm that the agent is online or that execution succeeded.
inbound_managed_help: Managed model: accepted events are queued for the existing private canvas executor. Enabled does not mean a run has succeeded.
inbound_error: Could not complete this event action. Check permissions and retry.
inbound_changed: The rule or workflow changed. Save disabled and review it again.
